wezkty:247: The three-level content layering (L0/L1/L2) and dynamic injection strategy solve the core pain point of enterprise Agents—the contradiction between the limited context window and the richness of the knowledge base. The three-tier mechanism of "short-session pass-through, long-session sampling, hard budget with soft degradation" ensures that the system still has predictable behavior under extreme conditions, rather than crashing randomly. Progressive tool loading (Deferred Tool Registry) changes tool selection from "full enumeration" to "on-demand wake-up." The accuracy improvement from 70% to 90% proves the effectiveness of this strategy. The insight behind this is: the more tool descriptions there are in the context window, the easier it is for the model to get lost—not because the tool descriptions are insufficiently detailed, but because there is too much distracting information.
